title.narrative: SOS Chidrens Village in Lesotho - Circular Economy Youth Empowerment Project
SOS Childrens Village in Lesotho- Circular Economy Youth Empowerment Project

description.narrative: The project aims to target young people through capacity building for job creation and entrepreneurship in the circular economy.The target group will be young people who have gone through vocational skills training in Fashion design, construction and culinary arts. SOS will collaborate with Sebabatso social incubator to implement this project.The project will support skills development and employment creation of youth age between 15- 30 especially females who have dropped out of school. A total of 200 beneficairies will be targeted for training at the end of the project 30 bussiness on circular economy will be the outcome. The projects is for 20 monhsand it will be implemented in Hlotse in the Leribe District .
